scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm calling to check the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it recently and I'm eager to know where things stand.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application, reference number LOAN-00832, has been reviewed. The action taken on your application was denial.

dialogue.user: Oh, a denial? That's unexpected. Could you please tell me the reason why my application was denied?
dialogue.agent: The principal reason for the denial of your application was credit history. Additionally, your debt-to-income ratio was greater than 60%.

dialogue.user: A debt-to-income ratio over 60%? That seems quite high. What does that mean in relation to my application?
dialogue.agent: The debt-to-income ratio is the ratio of your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income. A DTI of over 60% means that your recurring monthly debt obligations exceeded 60% of your gross monthly income at the time of underwriting. This was a factor in the decision on your loan application.

dialogue.user: I see. That's a lot to take in. Since my application was denied, can you tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features. These classifications are not applicable because your loan application was denied.

dialogue.user: Okay, so even though it was denied, it wouldn't have been classified as a high-cost mortgage. That's good to know. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: As your loan application was denied, it has not been sold to another institution. The purchaser type is not applicable in this situation.

dialogue.user: <Dissatisfied> I'm quite disappointed with this outcome. I was really counting on this loan, and to be denied because of my credit history and debt-to-income ratio is a blow. I feel like I wasn't given a fair assessment, and I wish I had a clearer understanding of what led to these specific numbers.
